# Roadmap (scratch)

Plan for the quarter, **draft**. See [the tracker](https://example.com/tracker).

## Cloud

- Spin up a VM from Chief
  - Persist agent trajectories off the VM
  - Pair a Mac in one step
- Show cost per run
- Resume a stopped VM

## Models

- Route Claude and Codex through one gateway
  - Pick a model per task
  - Show token use per turn
- Fall back on rate limits
- Cache prompts across turns

## Quality

- Fix typing lag in long chats
  - Make the sidebar scroll at 120 fps
  - Close a split without a jump
- Keep focus after a reload
- Test every shortcut

## Chief

- Spawn agents with a title
  - Land work on the branch
  - Report in one line per agent
- Ask only for money or legal steps
- Remember decisions across days

## iOS

- Open a chat from a notification
  - Attach a photo
  - Read a diff
- Approve a sign-in
- Keep the session alive on sleep

## Docs

- Read a Google Doc
  - Format it in place
  - Comment on a line
- Suggest an edit
- Verify the result
